summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of CoolDesk AC-complaint ticketing platform. Backend: 23/23 pytest tests passed covering auth, public form, tickets CRUD/updates/replies, brand admin CRUD, agent create/login/RBAC/delete, settings, test-email, meta. Frontend: end-to-end Playwright script covered public dealer form submission (VOLT-000003 with brand-prefixed number), admin login redirect, tickets list with search, ticket-detail status/priority/assign/reply flow, brands/agents/settings pages load, and 'Send test email' success toast (via emergent).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — migrate to lifespan context manager.

CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' but with allow_credentials=True this is invalid per CORS spec; browsers may reject. Ensure CORS_ORIGINS env is set explicitly (currently working because same-origin via ingress).

resolve_collaborators only falls back to default_stakeholders when BOTH catch_all_emails AND routing are empty. Spec says 'always CC' catch-all + fallback — current behavior matches, but consider explicit precedence docs.
Cookie set with samesite='none' + secure=True — correct for cross-site preview URL; good.
next_ticket_number relies on find_one_and_update upsert=True — good, atomic. No index on counters.id — add unique index to be safe.
No pagination on /api/tickets (to_list(1000)) — will scale-fail beyond 1000.
seed_data_creation: Tests created TEST_ prefixed tickets (VOLT-000002, VOLT-000003, LG-000001, LG-000002), a transient TEST_ brand (created+updated+deleted), and a transient agent user (created+deleted). Some TEST_ tickets remain in DB by design (no delete endpoint).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py is a full regression pytest suite (23 tests). Uses admin creds from test_credentials.md. Agent-role RBAC uses a separate requests.post (not the shared Session) to avoid cookie clobber. Public form testids: brand-select/type-select/subject-input/description-input/customer-name-input/customer-phone-input/dealer-name-input/dealer-phone-input/submit-complaint-button/ticket-number-result. Ticket list row testid: ticket-row-{TICKET_NUMBER}.
